sites.title: Broadway & Columbus
sites.summary: A North Beach junction, recorded from a static roadside sensor.

The field mark for this site reads 'Broadway below Telegraph Hill, near Sansome', which is about 600 m from where the sensor actually stood; the junction name is the better fix and overrides it. Correcting the mark would rename this scene.
